main_text.p: maior & grauior accedit causa, Authoris ipsius suprema voluntas Testameto consignata, qua quicquid supererat operum ipsius sub tuo nomine exire voluit, & solennia haec dedicationis verba praefeferre, Gvlielmo Scoto In Perpetvvm Testimonivm Amicitiæ Nostræ Dedico Consecroqve. Accipe igitur hoc grati animi testimonium qualecunq; Analysin Logicam in Epistolam ad Hebraeos, simulq; breue tractatum de Iustificatione, quæ ideo placuit cum hac Analysi coiungere, quòd & propter breuitatè seorsim excudi non poterat, & ad quæstionem de Iustificatione hominis coram Deo determinanda doctrina de Christi sacerdotio, quæ in hac ad Hebraeos Epistola accuratissimè tractatur, singulare visum habeat, cùm illa ipsa oblatio & sacrificiū quod Sacerdos Christus Patri ad expiāda peccata nostra in cruce obtulit, sit vnica illa iustitia quā nobis Deus imputat, & propter quam nos è tribunali suo iustos esse pronunciat. Hanc autem Analysin

page.notes: Page is a column of running text; the last printed line ends mid-sentence ("Analysin") and continues on the next page. Some spelling is original (e.g. "Testameto", "quòd"). The empty foot paragraph above is a placeholder and should be ignored; no footnotes are printed. Hyphenated line-end words were joined: "Authoris" (from "Autho-ris"), "Epistolam", "Epi-ftolam", "accuratissimè" from "accuratif-fimè", "expiāda" retained as printed.
